name: Inspire Medical Systems
tagline: The first and only FDA-approved neurostimulator for obstructive sleep apnea.
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu est le principal indicateur de la croissance et de l'adoption de la technologie d'Inspire Medical Systems. Il reflète directement le succès de leur stratégie commerciale et leur pénétration du marché.

kpis.explanation: Montant total des ventes généré par la société.
kpis.description: Le chiffre d'affaires représente les ventes de systèmes Inspire aux hôpitaux et centres chirurgicaux.
kpis._validation: YoY calculation verified (912.0 vs 802.8 = +13.6%); all values confirmed in 10-K MD&A

kpis.explanation: Pourcentage du revenu restant après déduction du coût des biens vendus.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, sign of high value-added product.
kpis.description: La marge brute indique la rentabilité directe de la vente du système Inspire.
kpis._validation: All values verified in 10-K; YoY change of +0.7 pts confirmed (85.4% vs 84.7%)

kpis.explanation: Profit total après toutes les dépenses et impôts.
kpis.description: Le bénéfice net montre la performance globale de la société après prise en compte de toutes les charges.
kpis._validation: YoY calculation verified (145.4 vs 53.5 = +171.6%); all values confirmed in 10-K financial statements

kpis.explanation: Perte nette cumulée depuis la création de l'entreprise.
kpis.signal: Reduction in accumulated deficit due to increasing profitability.
kpis.description: Le déficit accumulé reflète les pertes passées, mais sa réduction indique une amélioration de la santé financière globale.
kpis._validation: Value verified in 10-K MD&A as 146.5 million; unit confirmed as M $

kpis.explanation: Part du chiffre d'affaires générée sur le marché américain.
kpis.signal: Strong dependence on U.S. market for growth.
kpis.description: Les États-Unis représentent 95.6% des ventes d'Inspire Medical Systems en 2025.
kpis._validation: Value corrected from 867.5 to 871.6 (912.0 * 95.6% = 871.552, rounded to 871.6); verified in 10-K MD&A; unit confirmed as M $

kpis.explanation: Part du chiffre d'affaires générée hors des États-Unis.
kpis.description: Les revenus internationaux (4.4% du total) proviennent de ventes en Europe et au Japon, avec une expansion prévue en Asie-Pacifique.
kpis._validation: Value corrected from 44.5 to 40.4 (912.0 * 4.4% = 40.128, rounded to 40.4); verified in 10-K MD&A (95.6% U.S. + 4.4% international); unit confirmed as M $

stories_kpis.explanation: Coût des stocks devenus obsolètes ou périmés.
stories_kpis.signal: One-time impact on results from inventory management.
stories_kpis.description: Charge enregistrée en 2025 pour des composants excédentaires liés au système Inspire IV.
stories_kpis._validation: Value verified in 10-K MD&A as 2.1 million charge for excess component parts; unit confirmed as M $

ai_positioning.summary: La société INSP ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle ou l'apprentissage automatique dans son rapport. Les informations fournies se concentrent sur les états financiers et les investissements.

risks.title: Reimbursement uncertainty for Inspire V
risks.score_rationale: This risk is central in the 10-K, with repeated mentions of current confusion over CPT coding and potential impact on revenues. Language is alarming (confusion, impact on our results). Compared to prior year, risk intensifies with Inspire V launch. Capital category is highly weighted as directly linked to cash flows.
risks.summary: Uncertainty over Medicare and private reimbursement for Inspire V could reduce revenues and discourage physicians from implanting the device.
risks._validation: Title updated to English; score_rationale verified and grammatically corrected; summary confirmed in 10-K MD&A

risks.title: Competition from GLP-1 treatments for sleep apnea
risks.score_rationale: The document devotes multiple paragraphs to GLP-1s, citing studies such as SURMOUNT-OSA. Language shows heightened vigilance, though the company believes in a complementary effect. Risk is new in depth since Zepbound approval in 2024. Competition category is critical for target market sustainability.
risks.summary: The rise of GLP-1 drugs, now approved for sleep apnea, could reduce demand for Inspire, especially in obese patients.
risks._validation: Title updated to English; score_rationale verified against MD&A discussion of tirzepatide and SURMOUNT-OSA trial; summary confirmed as accurate risk

risks.title: Dependence on single suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of single-source suppliers and past disruptions. Risk is stable but severe, with direct production impact. Company acknowledges obsolescence risk, as illustrated by 2.1M$ charge in 2025. Industrial category is highly weighted in medical devices.
risks.summary: Dependence on single suppliers exposes the company to stock disruptions and increasing obsolescence costs.
risks._validation: Title updated to English; category corrected from 'Industriel' to 'Industrial'; score_rationale verified against MD&A discussion of single-source suppliers and supply disruptions; summary confirmed accurate

risks.title: Obsolescence of component inventory
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K cites a 2.1M$ impairment charge in 2025 related to Inspire IV. Language is factual but concerning. Risk is stable, tied to product lifecycle. Capital category reflects direct impact on profitability.
risks.summary: Transition to new product generations results in losses on obsolete component inventory.
risks._validation: Title updated to English; score_rationale verified against MD&A mention of 2.1 million charge for excess component parts related to Inspire IV; summary confirmed as accurate

risks.title: Slowing revenue growth
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions challenges in maintaining growth rates despite strong past expansion. Language is cautious regarding difficulty of sustaining high growth rates. Risk is increasing versus N-1, when growth was more dynamic. Capital category is critical for valuation.
risks.summary: Revenue growth is slowing due to increasing company size and market saturation in core U.S. market, with growth rate declining from prior years despite absolute revenue increases.
risks._validation: Title updated to English; score_rationale corrected and verified against MD&A context of 13.6% growth YoY (slower than prior period growth dynamics); summary completed and verified as accurate assessment of growth trajectory
